scope: Only protocol.json and read_firstfile.py reviewed. No runner execution and no battery member/data payload read.

material_reasons.issue: The protocol requires reporting the final negative-current sample, but the runner only emits its voltage and discharge-capacity counter. It omits that sample's time and current, so the requested boundary observation is incomplete.

Cycles are accumulated in a dictionary keyed by cycle index. If a cycle index reappears after another index, separated source runs are merged, so the output would not preserve every cycle occurrence in source order as required. No assertion rejects this case.

bounded_observations: Protocol correctly limits the action to one fixed archive member and explicitly disallows EOL creation, full-life normalization, model inference, fitting, and other cell/date reads.
Runner checks the acquired archive hash and fixed member size/CRC before reading the member payload; the one-time claim is created before that payload read; missing or ambiguous schema fails closed.

The reported negative-segment integral uses only adjacent samples both below the negative-current threshold, omitting transition intervals. It must remain described as a sampled partial integral and not as complete discharge capacity evidence. Existing labels make it an integral estimate; preserve that limitation in output interpretation.
required_before_go: Emit final negative sample time and current (alongside the existing voltage/capacity fields).
Preserve contiguous source cycle runs or fail closed when an index reappears after another cycle; do not silently merge separated runs.
Keep the internal-sample-only integral explicitly partial in the result limitations.
go_file_status: Not assessed and not required for this review decision; absence of a future GO was not treated as a blocker.
recommendation: Correct the narrow runner issues, then bind any new review/GO to the revised protocol and runner hashes. No data read is authorized by this review.
